answer: Clone fleets cannot share one tidal gate. An applicant bonds 9.05 POA and is assigned a single inlet lock on a spiral causeway that reaches a quarantine island for 13 minutes. They must lower a 21.8 cm sounding spiral into that lock, stamp a 16-bit flood hash of tide-rung, pubkey, and epoch seed, and seat it before the lock empties in seconds 18-45. 85 aliases would freeze 769.25 POA and need 85 exclusive locks. Auditors replay the lock draw from the seed, regenerate the hash, and measure the spiral to 0.06 cm. A reused lock, early ebb, or hash clash burns 48% and bars that inlet for 8 epochs.
